decision: AC1 2026-10-10 (studio-rules d.9): up to 20 CJ sourcing requests via the official API
endpoint: POST /product/sourcing/create (productName, productImage, remark; no productUrl, no price)
daily_limit: 5 per day, verified 2026-10-10: the 6th request was refused with code 1600000 'Exceeded the daily source limit'
poll: python3 scripts/sourcing/cj_source.py --by sourcing-support source-status <cjSourcingId> ...  (GET /product/sourcing/queryList?sourceIds=...; sourceStatus 3 = succeeded -> cjProductId/cjVariantSku, 5 = failed -> failReasonStr)
